blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Deputy Speaker Janette Garin said she pities Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers for the impeachment trial as it is hard to defend against the prosecution’s evidence, especially if it refers to indisputable numbers and hard data. Garin, in a press briefing on Wednesday said that they hope Duterte herself would show up and answer the issues raised against her regarding Article II of the Articles of Impeachment, which states that she amassed unexplained wealth and failed to declare it in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN).
